start: Settings, Your gym, What my gym can see; member linked to a gym

steps.action: Switch on 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard'
must_not: The board showing a full name rather than first name and initial

steps.action: Close the app and open it again
must_not: The gym told something different from the switch

start: Settings, Your gym and Reminders; the gym has Busy machines and trainer view on

steps.action: Switch 'Reminders from my gym' and 'Messages from my gym'
user_sees: Both on by default; each keeps the member's choice
must_not: Gym reminders or message pop-ups shown while switched off

user_sees: Shown only when the gym switched Busy machines on
must_not: The switch shown for a gym without Busy machines

steps.action: Switch on 'Share my workouts with my trainers'
user_sees: Shown only when the gym uses trainer view
must_not: A trainer seeing the summary while the switch is off

start: What my gym can see, phone offline

steps.action: Switch the leaderboard name off with no internet
must_not: An error with no way on

steps.action: Come back online and open the app
user_sees: The gym's board now shows 'A member'
must_not: The gym never told (name still shown)

start: 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' On, workouts shared

user_sees: The switch off; the shared workouts deleted at once
must_not: Gym mates still able to open the workouts
Old shares coming back without the member choosing

start: New member, linked to a gym, never opened these switches

steps.action: Open What my gym can see
user_sees: Name on leaderboard off, gym mates off, trainers off; 'Share which machines I use' on
must_not: The name, workouts or trainer summary shared before the member chose
Body weight, photos or notes shared by any switch

steps.action: Gym mates open the member's workouts
user_sees: Only while 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' is on
must_not: Workouts open to gym mates with the name switch off
